units.source_text: 她在那废墟上遭到一伙阿拉伯恶汉的袭击，被他们带到荒无人烟的沙漠中去。

en.t: She was attacked by a band of Arab ruffians in those ruins and taken by them into a deserted desert.

units.source_text: 可是，恶汉们郑重地对待她，到了令人毛骨悚然的地步，只索取两万美元来赎身。

en.t: Yet the villains treated her with a chilling solemnity and demanded only twenty thousand dollars as ransom.
Far from her homeland, with no one who knew her...

units.source_text: 她万般无奈，脑海里忽然浮现出一个埃及人，就是那个埃及青年。

en.t: At her wits' end, an Egyptian suddenly came to her mind: that young Egyptian man.
